timeout.label: Start after (seconds)
timeout.description: Seconds without keyboard or mouse input before the screensaver starts.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: One image that always bounces. White art on a transparent background tints best. Leave empty to pick a random logo each time.

logo_folder.label: Logo folder
logo_folder.description: Folder of .svg, .png or .webp images; a random one bounces each time. Used when Logo is empty. Leave empty for the built-in logos.
